tender_title: Comprehensive Operation & Maintenance of Civil & Electromechanical assets for Radhanpur-Santalpur RWSS for 60 months

corrigenda_status.summary: The supplied 175-page Volume I PDF contains zero internal corrigenda or addenda. No external or separate corrigenda documents were provided or checked through authorized portals.

jv_policy.prohibition_reason: Tender Volume I mandates qualification in bidder own name and style. Forms strictly accommodate only Individual, Partnership, or Limited Company/Corporation. Arithmetic pooling across consortium partners is prohibited.

financial_scenario_expression.expression_structure: (SCENARIO_1 [Turnover >= 4.0 Cr in 3 of 5 Yrs AND Experience >= 1.0 Yr]) OR (SCENARIO_2 [Turnover >= 10.0 Cr in 3 of 5 Yrs])

scenario_1.years_required: 3 out of last 5 financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26)
scenario_1.experience_scope: Water supply network, WTP, pumping machineries, intake/offtake structure, storage structures, municipal STP, or sewage network

scenario_2.years_required: 3 out of last 5 financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26)

criteria.title: Minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 4 Crores in any three financial years out of the last five financial years (Scenario 1).
criteria.verbatim_quote: Turnover: Bidder must have achieved minimum annual financial turnover (at current price level) from contract receipt of works (in all classes of civil engineering construction works or O&M services only) of Rs. 4 Crores in any three financial years out of last Five (5) financial years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Turnover for 2021-2022 to 2025-2026 must be certified by a Chartered Accountant on letterhead.
criteria.verbatim_quote: The details pertaining to Turnover for the year 2021-2022 to 2025-2026 shall be certified by Chartered Accountant on his own letter head and duly attested.
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Contract termination if monthly penalties exceed 25% of the billing amount for 4 consecutive months.
criteria.verbatim_quote: If applicable penalties for each month exceed 25% of billing amount per month, for a block of 4 consecutive months, then contract shall be liable for termination.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (SLA penalty threshold, not an upfront qualification gate).

criteria.title: Contract termination if cumulative penalties exceed 10% of the total contract value.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Cumulative penalties levied against non-performance in any of the SLA (viz. operational, preventive or curative maintenance) exceeds 10% of the total contract value.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (SLA penalty threshold, not an upfront qualification gate).

criteria.title: Minimum insurance limit per occurrence shall be Rs. 5 Lacs with no limit on occurrences.
criteria.verbatim_quote: This insurance shall be for a limit of per occurrence of not less than the amount of Rs. 5 Lacs, with no limit on the number of occurrences.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (post-award insurance obligation).

criteria.title: Depreciated value considered is Rs. 3435.53 lac for insurance purposes.
criteria.verbatim_quote: The depreciated value is considered Rs.3435.53 lac for the purpose of insurance for respective year.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (post-award insurance obligation).

criteria.title: Security Deposit shall be equal to 10% of the estimated cost or contract value (Part A & B of price bid) whichever is higher.
criteria.verbatim_quote: pay the total amount of Security Deposit equal to 10 (ten) percent of the estimated cost or contract value (Part A & B of price bid) whichever is higher for the work put to tender.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (Performance security deposit).

criteria.title: 5% of the lump sum fees is held back from each payment as retention money.
criteria.verbatim_quote: 5% (five) of the lumpsum fees shall be held back from each payment, as Retention money as per Clause 1 of General Conditions of Contract.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (statutory cess and billing retention deductions).

criteria.title: A 1% labour cess is recovered from the contractor's running account bill.
criteria.verbatim_quote: As per Building and other construction works welfare cess act and the provision under Rule No.5 of the rules of 1998 of Gujarat State, the 1% cess shall be recovered from the running account bill of the contractor.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (statutory cess and billing retention deductions).

criteria.title: Contractor must have 'A' class or higher registration in R&B/WRD of Govt. of Gujarat.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Any bidder with “A” class& aboveof registration or higher in R&B/WRD of Govt. of Gujarat. However, the bidder will have to Post Qualify as per Financial & Technical Criteria given in the bid document.
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Experience certificates must be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
criteria.verbatim_quote: The experience certificate from the client equivalent to not below the rank of Executive Engineer shall be considered.
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Bidder must submit a list of O&M works of similar nature completed during the last 5 financial years from 2021-22 to 2025-26 up to one month prior to bid submission deadline.
criteria.verbatim_quote: List of O & M works of similar nature already completed by the bidder during last 5 financial years i.e. From 2021-22 to 2025-26& up to one month prior to last date of submission of the bid
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Comprehensive O&M contract duration is 60 months covering 1 City, 126 villages, 11 Hamlets, and 6 Village Tube Wells.
criteria.verbatim_quote: The board intends to hire contractor for comprehensive O&M through e-tendering system for a duration of 60 (sixty) months for the Radhanpur&SantalpurRWSSschemecovering 1 City/126 villages/ 11 Hamlets and 6Nos Village Tube WellsSpread across Taluka: Radhanpur and SantalpurDistrict: Patan based on NMC at RankpurHW.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as TECHNICAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS / SCOPE.

criteria.title: Mandatory requirement to provide a 4-seater pickup truck as utility vehicle for pipeline inspection and repair.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Provide utility vehicle for pipeline inspection and repair activities by agency. Quantity as per Annexure III. This utility vehicle shall be a 4-seater pickup truck (utility vehicle) (mandatory).
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as TECHNICAL; reclassified to TECHNICAL_SPECS_AND_SCOPE.

criteria.title: O&M Manager must have minimum 7 years of experience and MBA/PGDM or Bachelor's degree in relevant engineering.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Minimum 7 years of experience
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Maintenance Engineer (Supervisor) must have minimum 5 years of experience and a Bachelor's degree in relevant engineering.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Minimum 5 years of experience
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Asst. Maintenance Engineer must have minimum 1 year of experience and a Bachelor's degree in relevant engineering.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Minimum 1 years of experience
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Operators must have minimum 1 year of experience with ITI/Diploma or B.Sc in relevant field.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Minimum 1 year of experience
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Earth pit resistance must not exceed 1 ohm.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Measure resistance of earth pit. Resistance shall not exceed 1 ohm.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as TECHNICAL; reclassified to TECHNICAL_SPECS_AND_SCOPE (operating equipment maintenance standard).

criteria.title: Tender Fee requirement
criteria.verbatim_quote: Rs. 18000/- (Rupees Eighteen Thousand Only)
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as OTHERS; reclassified to BID_SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST.

criteria.title: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) requirement
criteria.verbatim_quote: Rs. 20,23,000.00(Rupees Twenty Lacs Twenty-Three Thousand Only)
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as OTHERS; reclassified to BID_SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST.

criteria.title: Must have valid registration as 'A' Class & above Civil or Electrical Contractor in R&B / Water Resources Department, Govt of Gujarat.
criteria.verbatim_quote: The bidder must have a valid registration as “A” Class & above as Civil or Electrical Contractor in R & B / Water Resources Department, Government of Gujarat
criteria.verification_notes: Verified verbatim in PDF.

criteria.title: Incorrect declarations lead to 3-year debarment and forfeiture of security deposit.
criteria.verbatim_quote: If this declaration is found to be incorrect then without prejudice to any other action that may be taken I/weshall be debarred from bidding in GWSSB/GWIL tender for three yearsand my/our security deposit may be forfeited
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as OTHERS; reclassified to OTHER_ELIGIBILITY (Disqualification / debarment penalty).

criteria.title: Definition of maintenance and repairing period years from 2026 to 2030.
criteria.verbatim_quote: The agency shall consider the maintenance and repairing period as follows: 2026 as the 1st year, 2027 as the 2nd year, 2028 as the 3rd year, 2029 as the 4th year, 2030 as the 5th year.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as OTHERS; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS.

criteria.title: Contractor must not employ any person under the age of 18 years.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Minimum age of person employed: No Contractor shall employ any person who is under the age of 18 years.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as OTHERS; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (statutory labor condition).

criteria.title: The Operation and Maintenance period is 5 years from the date of issue of the work order.
criteria.verbatim_quote: The O & M Period shall commence from the date of issue of work order and shall continue for a period of 5 years there from.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as OTHERS; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS.

criteria.title: Liquidated damages for delay at 0.1% per day up to a maximum of 10% of estimated tender cost or contract value.
criteria.verbatim_quote: Liquidated damages at the rate of 0.1% of contract value per day of delay subjected to the maximum amount of 10% of the Estimated amount put to tender or total contract value whichever is higher, shall be recovered from the contractor.
criteria.verification_notes: Originally classified as OTHERS; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS.

criteria.title: Turnover Scenario-2 Alternate Qualification Threshold
criteria.verbatim_quote: Scenario-2 a) Turnover: Bidder must have achieved minimum annual financial turnover (at current price level) from contract receipt of works (in all classes of civil engineering construction works or O&M services only) of Rs. 10 Crores in any three financial years out of last Five (5) financial years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
criteria.verification_notes: CRITICAL: Provides alternate qualification pathway if bidder lacks 1-year water O&M experience but has >= Rs. 10 Cr annual turnover.

criteria.title: Turnover Annual Price Escalation Weightage Formula
criteria.verbatim_quote: Turnover of previous year shall be given additional weightage of ten percent per year to bring them to current price level to account for price escalation as illustrated below: 2021-2022: 1.61 x F, 2022-2023: 1.46 x E, 2023-2024: 1.33 x D, 2024-2025: 1.21 x C, 2025-2026: 1.10 x B, Base Year 2026-2027: 1.00 x A.
criteria.verification_notes: CRITICAL: Evaluator must multiply past years turnover by compounding escalation factors (up to 1.61x).

criteria.title: Bidder Legal Constitution Requirement
criteria.verbatim_quote: The bidder should be a company registered under Companies Registration act 1956/2013 or Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, or a Proprietorship registered in India as on bid submission date.
criteria.verification_notes: MANDATORY: Restricts eligible entities to Indian Registered Company, LLP, or Proprietorship.

criteria.title: Comprehensive Blacklisting / Debarment Gate
criteria.verbatim_quote: Bidder should not be under the effect of blacklisting/debarment by any Ministry of Government of India or by any State Government of any other State in India or by Government of Gujarat or any of the Government PSUs at the time of bidding.
criteria.verification_notes: CRITICAL: Broad government-wide debarment check required.

criteria.title: Electrical Contractor License Requirement
criteria.verbatim_quote: Electrical contractor’s license issued by Electric Licensing Board, Gandhinagar
criteria.verification_notes: CRITICAL: Mandatory statutory license for electromechanical operations.

criteria.title: Absolute Subcontractor & Sublet Experience Disqualification
criteria.verbatim_quote: Experience as sub-contractor shall not be considered... The experience of sublet works shall not be considered.
criteria.verification_notes: CRITICAL: Prime contractor experience only; subcontracted experience is completely rejected.

criteria.title: Minimum Experience Duration for Scenario-1
criteria.verbatim_quote: The bidder shall have successfully completed operation and maintenance for minimum 1 years for any water supply system or part of its civil or electromechanical components such as water supply network, WTP, pumping machineries, intake/ offtake structure, storage structures, municipal STP or municipal sewage network etc. in last Five (5) financial years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
criteria.verification_notes: CRITICAL: Defines the minimum duration (1 year) and valid facility types for Scenario 1 experience.

criteria.title: Government / Board / Corporation Issuing Authority Requirement
criteria.verbatim_quote: The experience of O & M works executed in Government (State/Central), Board, Corporation, and Government Undertaking /Organisations of state & central government shall only be considered for evaluation... In case of Nagarpalika, the experience certificate of duly Sign by Chief officer shall only be considered.
criteria.verification_notes: CRITICAL: Rejects private client experience; requires Govt/PSU/Nagarpalika client certificate.

criteria.title: Bid Validity and EMD Validity Periods
criteria.verbatim_quote: Bid Validity Period: 180 Days from the last date of submission of bid... EMD valid up to 28 days from the date of closure of the bid validity period of 180 days i.e. (Total of 180+28=208 days)
criteria.verification_notes: PROCEDURAL: Bidder offer must remain valid for 180 days; BG must be for 208 days.

criteria.title: Physical Instrument Submission Deadline & 3-Year Banning Rule
criteria.verbatim_quote: bidder shall send the same in original through SPEED POST/HAND DELIVERY so as to reach to “Executive Engineer, Public Health Works Division- Radhanpur... of Seven days from the last date of bidding by 15:00. For not submitting DD/FDR/BG in original, bidder shall be banned to participate in any tender of the Board for period of 3 years as a penal action.
criteria.verification_notes: CRITICAL GATE: Physical submission within 7 days is mandatory; failure invokes 3-year ban.

criteria.title: Non-Judicial Stamp Paper Form-H Declaration
criteria.verbatim_quote: TO BE EXECUTED ON NON-JUDICIAL E-STAMP PAPER OF Rs. 300/- AND SUBMITTED BY THE TENDERER ALONGWITH HIS TENDER IN A SEPARATE COVER
criteria.verification_notes: PROCEDURAL: Form-H must be on Rs. 300 stamp paper and notarized.

criteria.title: Litigation History 10-Year Disclosure Requirement
criteria.verbatim_quote: Company’s history of litigation or arbitration / Debarment / Blacklisting from contract executed in the last ten years or currently under execution. Please indicate for each case the year, name of employer, cause, matter in dispute, disputed amount, and whether the award was for or against the company.
criteria.verification_notes: EVALUATED: Full 10-year litigation and arbitration history must be provided in Form 6.

criteria.title: Prohibition of Multiple Bids by Same Bidder
criteria.verbatim_quote: Not more than one tender shall be submitted by a Bidder... A bidder who submits more than one bid in the particular work will be disqualified.
criteria.verification_notes: DISQUALIFYING: Strict rule against multiple entity submissions.

criteria.title: Joint Venture / Consortium Omission (Inherent Single-Entity Rule)
criteria.verbatim_quote: To qualify, each bidder in the same name and style should have achieved the following performances... Bid is submitted as: a) An individual/ proprietary firm, b) A partnership firm, c) A limited Company or Corporation.
criteria.verification_notes: ARCHITECTURAL: Zero JV clauses exist in this tender; bids must be submitted by a single entity in the same name and style.
